description: Find temporary decisions and workarounds that accidentally became permanent, with interest costs.
notes: Shared kit was not present at build time; a minimal local Kit fallback is inlined.

notes.note: 'Temporary workarounds are the highest-interest debt' is a great line, and pricing the interest creates real payoff urgency. But engineers won't maintain another ledger — it becomes Jira-with-guilt. The CTO sale is plausible; the daily-use habit is the fantasy. Already scored 6; fair.
Tabs, debt detail modal, Log-a-shortcut saves new row; zero errors.

notes.change: New 'Payoff sprint' tab — debts ordered by payback period (payoff cost ÷ monthly interest) with cumulative eng-hours and a copyable sprint plan (README next-3 #3). Debt modal's vague 'immediate' payback line now shows real computed math. Log-a-shortcut got data-core.
